summary: P0 Production Bug Fixes Verified - Dashboard Resilience & Gmail Admin UI. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend tests confirm dashboard loads with user name (not 'there') and non-admin users are blocked from admin pages.
passed_tests: Gmail debug-config endpoint returns 200 without authentication (public endpoint)
Gmail debug-config includes 'source' field indicating 'database' or 'env'
admin_integrations.py includes config_source field in Gmail status response
Dashboard.js has .catch() on all 6 Promise.all API calls (resilient)
Dashboard.js uses authUser?.name as fallback for name display
Layout.js passes user via Outlet context prop

dashboard_loads.greeting: Good evening, Clara - shows athlete name, not 'there'

name_display.details: Header shows 'Sarah' (user name), greeting shows 'Clara' (athlete name)

admin_access_blocked.details: Admin link not visible in sidebar for non-admin, direct navigation redirects to /board

gmail_oauth_ui_blocked.details: Gmail OAuth credential inputs not accessible for non-admin users

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js lines 256-263: All 6 API calls have .catch() fallbacks - prevents 'Failed to load dashboard' error
Dashboard.js line 252: Uses useOutletContext() to get authUser from Layout
Dashboard.js line 285: Name fallback chain is profile?.athlete_name || profile?.name || authUser?.name
Layout.js line 609: <Outlet context={{ user }} /> passes user to child routes
admin_integrations.py line 82: config_source field indicates 'database', 'env', or 'none'
gmail.py lines 277-303: Admin update-oauth-config endpoint with require_admin guard
seed_data_creation: None - tests used existing demo user
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bugs fixed: 1) Dashboard no longer shows 'Failed to load dashboard' because all 6 API calls have .catch() fallbacks. 2) Dashboard greeting shows actual athlete name via profile?.athlete_name || authUser?.name fallback chain. 3) Gmail admin endpoints require admin (douglas@yeslms.com) and return 403 for other users. 4) Gmail debug-config is public and includes config_source field.

dashboard_failure.original_bug: Dashboard shows 'Failed to load dashboard' when any API call fails
dashboard_failure.fix: All 6 API calls in Promise.all now have .catch() returning default values

name_display.original_bug: User's name shows as 'Hello there' instead of actual name
name_display.fix: Dashboard uses authUser.name from Outlet context as fallback

gmail_admin_ui.original_bug: Gmail connect fails with 'deleted_client' error - admin UI needed
gmail_admin_ui.fix: AdminIntegrations.js has Gmail OAuth credential inputs, backend has /api/gmail/admin/update-oauth-config
